contradictoryReasons.reason: Resume flagged: Under 200 words. System requires minimum 500-word narrative arc demonstrating personal growth journey.
Resume flagged: 200–399 words detected. Our ATS requires exactly 400 words. You are in the uncanny valley of resume length.
Resume flagged: 400–599 words. This is simultaneously too long for our initial screener and too short for our secondary screener. Paradox unresolvable.
Resume flagged: Over 600 words. Our hiring manager reads at a third-grade level by choice. Please condense your life's work to a single haiku.
Resume flagged: Corporate buzzword density exceeds acceptable threshold. Our culture rejects people who sound exactly like us.
Resume flagged: No recognized industry terminology detected. Please resubmit after completing our 12-week 'How to Sound Important' certification.
Resume flagged: Years of experience listed. We prefer candidates who have transcended the concept of linear time.
Resume flagged: No quantified experience metrics. How are we supposed to ignore your qualifications without numbers to ignore?
Resume flagged: Formal education detected. We are looking for someone who 'broke the mold,' not someone who attended one.
Resume flagged: No educational credentials found. While we publicly state we don't require degrees, the ATS requires a degree.
Resume flagged: Skills section detected. Listing skills implies you know what you're good at, which suggests dangerous levels of self-awareness.
Resume flagged: File successfully received. Automatic rejection triggered as per our standard operating procedure.

additionalReasons: Our algorithm detected an 'e' in your name, which conflicts with our current vowel quota.
Your resume was submitted on a day ending in 'y,' which our system flags as statistically suspicious.
Font choice suggests you are either overqualified or a comic book villain. We cannot take that risk.
Candidate appears to have gaps between their words, indicating a troubling comfort with empty space.
LinkedIn profile photo detected (via spiritual intuition). Candidate appears to be making direct eye contact, which violates company culture.
Resume lacks a section titled 'Why I Would Die for This Company.' Non-negotiable.

Resume contains the word 'I,' suggesting the candidate believes themselves to be an individual.
Applicant appears to have listed achievements, implying they expect to be judged on merit. Not a culture fit.
We sensed a subtle undercurrent of hope in your cover letter. We are not a company that can support that emotionally.
Your file size is not a prime number. We only hire candidates whose documents are mathematically elegant.
Our culture committee detected trace amounts of 'work-life balance' expectations. We wish you well on your journey.

openingLines: Thank you for investing an unreasonable amount of hope into this application.
We have thoroughly ignored your resume and have reached a decision.
After careful consideration (our server processed your file in 0.003 seconds), we regret to inform you.
We received thousands of applications for this role, all of which we rejected. Yours, however, was special.
Your application was reviewed by our state-of-the-art AI hiring system, which we named 'Kevin.' Kevin does not like you.
On behalf of the entire hiring committee (a single intern named Brayden), we have concluded our evaluation.
We were genuinely moved by your application. We then moved it to the trash.
Your qualifications were impressive. This is, unfortunately, exactly the problem.
